messages:
Alex: Quick sync — staging burn-in for the new Dedicated GPU pool is tentatively starting Mon 3/23. We need clear owners for: burn-in/perf harness, fallback runbook, node/firmware fixes, and capacity reservation reconciliation. Who can take what?
Maria: I can own the perf/burn-in scripts and test harness. Plan to run smoke -> perf -> regression. What SLA do we target for perf runs?
Kevin: I can own the fallback runbook and canary routing config. Need to confirm allowed fallback model variants (quantized-only?) and how to tag fallback capacity in routing.
Kris (PM): FYI there are customer reservations that begin wk of 4/6. We need final capacity reconciliation by 4/1 at the latest so sales & SRE can schedule.
Ana (devops): SRE-bot just posted a readiness summary: "12/16 staging nodes ready; 4 failing healthcheck (NVLINK errors)." Ticket opened for firmware/NIC work. ETA initial fixes 3/25.
sre-bot: node-check results: staging-cluster-a: nodes_ready=12, total=16, failing_nodes=[node-07,node-09,node-10,node-12], fail_reasons=[nvlink_error, pci-reset]. See: https://issues.internal/2304
Maria: Can we split work? Start smoke tests 3/23 on the 12 healthy nodes, then full perf after firmware patch on 3/25. That avoids blocking perf timelines.
Kevin: Split is fine. For fallback: prefer to fallback to redwood-3b-int8 and redwood-1.3b-int8 as cheaper variants. Ops: add label "fallback=true" to the pool instances so routing can pick them.
Ana (devops): Confirmed, I can add the label and update cluster tags. Will also push a firmware PR and schedule reboots during 3/24-3/25 maintenance window.
Alex: Good — proposed owner list: Maria -> perf harness & burn-in, Kevin -> fallback runbook & routing, Ana -> node fixes + tagging, Kris -> capacity reconciliation with sales. I will update runbook and the status doc. :thumbsup:
Kris (PM): For reconciliation, @Maria please post the estimated usable GPU-hours after perf (we need to map to customer reservations). Also we should capture reservation commands for repeatability.
Maria: Rough numbers after perf (est): smoke: ~10 nodes usable, full post-firmware: ~16 nodes -> ~256 GPU-hours/day at 16 GPUs. I'll pin exact numbers after perf run.
Alex: Reservation example for tracking (please review):
```
# reserve 8 GPUs for customer window
ri capacity reserve --pool dedicated-eu-west --gpus 8 --start 2026-04-06 --end 2026-04-20 --owner "acme-inc" --note "pilot commit"
```
Kevin: Looks good. @Ana please ensure that reserved slots are excluded from autoscale policies and tagged so runtime routing won't send traffic to them.
Ana (devops): Will do. I'll add the autoscale exclusion label and update the autoscaler config: `exclude_tags: ["reserved"]`.
Maria: Small ask — can someone do a quick code review on my new burn-in change that adds kv-cache warmups? @Kevin @Ana
Kevin: I'll take a look today.
Alex: OK wrap-up: start smoke 3/23 on healthy nodes, full perf & burn-in 3/25 after firmware, owners as listed. Kevin to draft fallback runbook by 3/24, Ana to update tags and autoscale exclusions during maintenance, Maria to post final GPU-hours and perf logs, Kris to reconcile reservations by 4/1. I'll send a short note to sales & success when we lock dates.
Maria: Ack. I'll post the perf checklist and test matrix tomorrow.
Ana (devops): Ticket #2304 updated with firmware PR link and maintenance window. ETA fixes 3/25.
Kevin: Drafted fallback runbook in docs repo and requested reviews. Ping me for quick review.
Kris (PM): Thanks all. If anything slips, flag ASAP so we can adjust customer windows.
Alex: Great work — closing this sync. Ping here for any blocking issues. :handshake:
